interface.longDescription: Use when a business needs annual three-statement Excel models for one sales line, or subscriptions with uniform monthly churn and constant monthly additions. Assess and classify every requirement before translating assumptions; agents must refuse unsupported needs, while code checks declared features and limited wording patterns. Package selects Summary with profit, cash, funding warnings and charts; opening in Excel itself is untested. Standard-library Python, live formulas, stored values and an offline preview.
